reading.title: How a Plant Grows
reading.purpose: Learn the steps a plant takes as it grows from a seed.
paras: A plant starts as a seed. Put the seed in the soil. Give it water and sun.
Soon the seed will sprout. A tiny green shoot comes up. The plant will grow and grow. Look every day. What do you see?

qs.q: We put the seed in the soil. What is soil?
choices: The dirt a plant grows in.
qs.why: Soil is the dirt that plants grow in.
The reading says to give the seed water and sun.

qs.q: A tiny green shoot comes up. What did the seed do?
qs.why: When a seed starts to grow a tiny green shoot, it sprouts.
